company_stage: large global professional services and consulting organization

culture_principles.name: Public mission and customer-impact alignment
culture_principles.description: Deloitte fit should connect work to the company outcomes and users described in cited public sources.

culture_principles.name: Evidence-backed execution
culture_principles.description: Strong answers should show practical judgment, clear tradeoffs, ownership, and outcomes rather than generic enthusiasm.

culture_principles.name: Impact that matters and can be measured
culture_principles.description: Public material frames the firm's purpose around impact that matters and real, measurable results rather than activity or deliverables alone.

culture_principles.name: Multidisciplinary teaming
culture_principles.description: Services are delivered by mixed audit, tax, consulting, and advisory teams, so handoffs and shared standards are part of the work rather than overhead.

culture_principles.name: Impact that survives review
culture_principles.description: Public positioning emphasizes measurable impact, which in practice means work that can be defended to a client, a regulator, or an internal quality reviewer.

hiring_signals.signal: Connects decisions to the users, customers, products, or markets named in public company sources.
Uses concrete examples to show ownership, learning, and measurable improvement.
Raises a quality or integrity concern early and shows how it was resolved without losing the relationship.
Delivers a deadline-bound piece of work while making dependencies and review points explicit.
Works effectively across disciplines and states what each function needed from the others.

anti_signals.anti_signal: Generic admiration for the company without a concrete role, customer, product, or business mechanism.
anti_signals.risk_reason: Public lens usage should stay grounded in cited source signals and role-relevant evidence.

anti_signals.anti_signal: Treating Deloitte as a single firm with one hiring bar across member firms and service lines.
anti_signals.risk_reason: The global network is legally and operationally distributed; public sources do not support a uniform standard.

anti_signals.anti_signal: Substituting brand prestige for a role-specific reason to join.
anti_signals.risk_reason: Brand recognition is not evidence of fit and is not tied to any cited public signal.

interview_patterns.pattern: Use cited public source signals to test role-relevant judgment, ownership, communication, and impact.

honest_limits: This is a lightweight public-source lens and does not represent an official Deloitte hiring standard.
It contains source metadata and non-verbatim public-safe signals only.
Role, team, seniority, location, and hiring manager can materially change interview emphasis.
This lens requires deeper multi-source validation before being promoted to FULLY_DISTILLED.
